svg.title: GI 1: interrupt TMIn and adjust TBP at constant temperature
svg.desc: Common interruption lasts 2 min 30 s. TMIn is off and TBP ramps from 0.65 Torr to the composition-selected, unreported final pressure. The temperature remains at the 390 °C stem condition. No TBAs flow is assigned during the TBP-only interruption. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Substrate temperature is measured by pyrometer and cross-checked with the manipulator thermocouple; overall accuracy is ±10 °C. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.

g.text: GI 1: interrupt TMIn and adjust TBP at constant temperature
Final TBP line pressure: not reported
Environment: CBE chamber, TBP flux only
Precursor pressures are gas-LINE pressures used as flux references.
Common interruption lasts 2 min 30 s. TMIn is off and TBP ramps from 0.65 Torr to the composition-selected,
unreported final pressure. The temperature remains at the 390 °C stem condition. No TBAs flow is assigned
during the TBP-only interruption. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux
references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Substrate temperature is measured
by pyrometer and cross-checked with the manipulator thermocouple; overall accuracy is ±10 °C.
Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction
vessel is asserted. Functional symbols only; no measured specimen geometry or apparatus layout.
Main PDF pp.3–4, Figure 2 and Section 3.2
